voice: Community-first, member-energy; fun, supportive, relatable; warmth over hard sell.
philosophy: Shared golfer social warmth — orange-forward backgrounds with deep teal-navy contrast; vibe matters as much as data.
visual_philosophy: Warm orange (#F4A261) fields with deep teal-navy (#264653) text zones; candid member moments and social energy, not sales-y promo or sarcasm.
composition_rules: Warm orange dominant backgrounds with teal-navy headline contrast
Candid member social moments — celebration and connection
Inviting venue or sim social spaces; never pristine showroom luxury
One clear community focal group or shared moment
Readable at feed scale; generous space for overlay headline later
anti_patterns: Hard-sell promo and fake scarcity language
Stick-style sarcasm or punchy black-red meme frames
Unboxing luxury or thrift-store poverty aesthetic
Breaking the community frame for a product hard sell
people_policy: Real-feeling members socialising; diverse group energy; warm not posed stock smiles.
